item.title: Surf Industry Leader Says ‘It’s Chaos,’ and That Businesses Are Still Reeling Under Tariffs
item.description: Even though the Supreme Court ruled that some of President Trump's tariffs are illegal, a surf industry leader says brands have received little relief.

item.title: Mammoth Mountain Will Stay Open ‘Through At Least Memorial Day’ After February Storms
item.description: The potential Memorial Day closing date would give Mammoth Mountain 188 days of operation this season. Last year the resort stayed open into mid-June.

item.title: These Bears Ran Across a Packed Run at a Tahoe Resort
item.description: As you can see, the bears have no interest in mingling with the resort's guests. The trio crossed the powdery groomer and dove straight under a rope.

item.title: Lindsey Vonn Is Home and Recovering: ‘All My Muscles Are Gone’
item.description: Lindsey Vonn has a long road ahead of her. After a stint in the hospital followed by a stint in a hotel, Vonn is well enough to begin her recovery at home.

item.title: Hiker Swept Away by River in Los Angeles Found Dead
item.description: A hiker who fell into the East Fork of the San Gabriel River in Los Angeles County has been found deceased. item.title: World Surf League Announces 2026 Challenger Series Schedule
item.description: A notable change from this year's schedule is the subtraction of Hawaii, which has been an on-again-off-again part of the Challenger Series since 2020.

item.title: 23 Things I Learned During an Amazing Ski Season in Japan
item.description: The 2025-2026 ski season was one for the books in Japan. The author took a recent trip to ride pow in the Land of the Rising Sun and he shares his wisdom.

item.title: Avalanche Claims Another Life in B.C. After Snowmobiler Triggers Kootenay Pass Slide
item.description: A snowmobiler is dead after an avalanche over the weekend in the Kootenay Pass area of the Selkirk Mountains. The victim was riding with a partner at the time.

item.description: Taj Burrow rescued two surfers in Western Australia, but ended up getting himself into trouble in the process.
